newsitem.title: FINLAND: CO-OP BANK HEAD KEEPS OPK DOOR OPEN FOR RENEGADES.
newsitem.headline: CO-OP BANK HEAD KEEPS OPK DOOR OPEN FOR RENEGADES.

text.p: The cooperative banks which have refused to join a new cooperative created by a majority of banks grouped around OKO should still consider joining, Osuuspankkikeskus (OPK) head Antti Tanskanen said on Tuesday.
"The banks which have remained outside should still consider joining," he said in a statement.

Some of the regional cooperative banks refusing to join OPK on Monday announced they would start cooperating with some 40 local savings banks, and that Aktia Bank -- central bank for the savings banks -- would offer central banking services for the cooperative banks as well. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, news@reuters.fi
